One way to save web pages is to "save page as complete html". This makes a number of files on your computer that work together to recreate the web page.

It installs as a "printer" in the list of printers on a computer. To save the page, one "prints" the page to the printer called "PDF999" and this generates a pdf file that the user can name and place in an appropriate folder.
